notes.title: Future changes for the game
notes.notes:
First I have to say something about the recent events involving the Lunar coins. Apparently there was a bug ON STEAM and some people were abusing it, as usual, indie devs were to blame. People were saying that we, devs, have bot accounts and there was a whole conspiracy theory about it.

Well, none of it is true. Valve informed us about the new stuff on the sale a few minutes before it started. I got 100 coins, which I used to get a pig head ( :lunar2019coolpig: ) :) 

It's sad to see how much prejudice we face, just because our game is cheap...



Now, one other thing that is bothering me is the art of the game. Andarilho started with a lowpoly art, later it was changed to a different art that I bought from a artist on the asset store. The thing is, that the artist has inpired his creation on another game, ?maybe too much?. Now I receive a lot of complaint because of that.

With that in mind I decided to go back to lowpoly. Having a simpler art in the game will make it easier to find it and the game will probably be developed faster.

I will stop everything I am doing now and I will start to replace a few things. For the next updates you will start see a few things being replaced and it will mix with the current art. The goal is to replace everything, little by little until everything is changed.


If you have any thoughts and / or suggestions about it, feel free to contact me through the forum on Steam or email.





SC Jogos

notes.title: About the next version..
notes.notes:
I'd like to say that the next version is almost ready, but I can't. Unfortunately everything that could possibly  go wrong with this project, went wrong...

It still a lot of things to do before releasing the new version, but I'd like to share a few screenshots from the game with you guys. The next version will contain the intractable houses that everyone was asking for.

A few things has changed in the game now, like, there are less houses in the city, I gave up on that functional city thing because nobody care about it and now the city is abandoned. There was quite a few improvements in the game to make it lighter, there are something like 30 types of trees now, instead only one type we had before.

But I'll describe all of this later, when I release the new version. Until there I will leave a few screenshots here for you guys to see what is coming...




http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26244652/19f4f40543213d3e8b655ae62f5b9aae7e4caa03.jpghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26244652/0dc393dec15559f528b58d9e467ecc49792b6218.jpghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26244652/28a5b72b91202b45a5e9ae1ab4c8a65725c66f1e.jpghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26244652/e362e38e9546e860f4a9809fa66a0448cb48f2f4.jpg


Edit: The new version(V.EA.0.7.0) is available on the beta branch, but, be aware that it may be unstable.
